Rugged tablet / 10.1″ / Windows 11 Pro Our pick for Windows

Tuga W10

The full desktop experience. Anywhere.

£649 No VAT to add. Free UK delivery in 7 to 10 working days

The W10 is the full desktop experience in a rugged package. An Intel N100 processor (up to 3.4GHz), 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage run Windows 11 Pro on a 10.1 inch IPS touchscreen. The port selection is what sets it apart: HDMI, RJ45 Ethernet, USB-C and USB-A for direct connections to plant, panels and network gear that has never seen Wi-Fi. Rated IP65 for dust and water jets, with a removable 5000mAh battery, NFC, a microSD slot and a pogo pin dock connector. Options include 4G LTE, GPS, a fingerprint reader, a 2D barcode scanner and a UHF RFID reader.
